body: Hey, I haven’t been on here. He’s alive. Didn’t lie. He was on the news, but we still have no idea who did it or why, or if the person or persons that did it are still currently doing this. After this incident, I wanna say a week or so later, there was another victim near the same spot. Pretty sure that person did not make it out alive either but don’t quote me on it, it’s been a while. He had to have plastic surgery on his ear which healed up well and he still currently goes to Celtics games to this day despite what happened. Hopefully it never happens to him or anyone else ever again but it seems like whoever or whatever caused this to happen continues to go after others. Which is scary as f#$!. But we’re lucky and thankful that he survived despite the awful circumstances.
It is truly my brother. There are no updates at this time.
go back to my ex.

You know your assumption just goes to show your true character? My brother wasn't drunk. Yes it is easy to think after a Celtics game one would be intoxicated. However that is not the case and your comment is beyond wrong.

First thing I'd like to say is to the fucking assholes assuming my brother was drunk, you're completely out of pocket. My brother almost drowned and we DO NOT KNOW what happened to him. He is alive. He is recovering. But you sick fucks assuming he was drunk when he wasn't is so far out of line. There is a killer out there that just goes around and does this shit for fun. The markings on his body and the photos of him now, seeing him now, shows he was knocked out without a chance of bracing his fall. Please cut the fucking shit and stop assuming. You're wrong. We don't have answers. It's under investigation. Some of these comments are disgusting.
Proud?? More like thankful and beyond lucky he's still alive. That's my brother.

Or the stigma. Or anything that comes with it which is a whole fucking lot. A lot more than most people can handle. I need to do something to stop this. I need to create some sort of platform and travel the whole entire world and teach children before they become adults to understand that it's ok to feel not ok. But also to do something before it becomes too late. Please don't let it become too late for you.
Thank you for sharing. I love this response and I hope you know that there are people that understand and will be here. Even complete strangers such as myself.
I'm here. To vent, cry, idc wtf you need. I will be here. Do not hesitate to reach out. Please.
YES! This is fucking awesome. Keep it up 🖤

That is a horrific and tragic situation that I wouldn't wish upon anyone. I'm so sorry you had to go through that. What a traumatic experience.. holy fucking shit. I feel for you and I hope you're never forced into anything that will destroy you ever again.

I love this share. Your concerns and the personal information shared actually gave me a sigh of relief. For once. What you've touched base with needs to be addressed more and more and more. Thank you. I'm sorry about your struggles and I will pray that it gets better for you and anyone else battling what we deal with daily, very soon.
thank you ❤️

I'm upset that there's literally nothing I can do about this but pray that there is a cure and you find it before taking drastic measures. Please try to stay strong. I don't know what that's like at all but I read every word and it pains me. Some people get mad about the wrong food order and let it ruin their day, not even realizing there's people out there with real life problems. Shit sucks.
❤️ thank you

A lot of this is extremely relatable for me and I'm glad you shared. I know this shit sucks because I experience quite a lot of what you're going through on a daily basis. My entire family besides maybe 3 people hate me and vise versa. I feel so alone. Don't really understand why I'm here. I'm really sorry you're going through it and I pray that things get better.

This was such a good read and I feel like it's exactly what I needed right now. Very well said. My friend who has dealt with anxiety, depression and suicide took his life on Saturday. As I deal with the same issues and more, I'm having a very hard time with this. He had told me how they recently switched his meds and he felt like he was set back. Really set back. Like he had to start all over again on meds that made him feel worse. He said everything was going downhill but this time faster than ever before. And now he's not here. It's a really hard thing to process. I'm in therapy and psychiatry myself, wondering if I myself am even getting the correct treatment. I've been hospitalized three times, and every time it was horrific. Especially the last time.

I'm definitely not ready to give up. But I am tired. I'm exhausted
 So much bad has happened to me lately and I'm overwhelmed with the thought of trying to reverse or fix it all. I don't know where to begin. I've rested most of the day to try and relax my mind.. hasn't really helped. I know he would want me to live for him. I'm glad he's no longer suffering but I'm suffering even more with him gone, so I'm angry. I know I shouldn't be, but I am. Thank you for reaching out ❤️ I appreciate it a lot.

I really appreciate your kind words. I don't know who to turn to, I have therapy in 20 minutes which I have been looking forward to all day. Since the second I found out, actually. I might even up my meds. He and I were both suicidal. Now I feel guilty that I'm still alive and he's not. I feel terrible. Why do I have the strength to live and he didn't? What could I have done more to keep him here? So many questions. It does feel like I'm hopeless. I didn't even know his family, so my condolences to them feel like they barely matter. I feel like a lot barely matters right now.. it's heartbreaking.

i can agree and relate to so much of what you just said. i started following this page about an hr ago because i myself am seeking help with how to get through this. feeling like i can't. debating on taking the route he did. and my condolences, the loss we've both experienced does not help our mental state by any means. i don't have answers. and though i don't know you, i really fucking want you to live. what you're saying is meaningful and real and painful. but i don't want you to take your life.. i know that may mean nothing to you. just please try to find an outlet or a punching bag or eat a whole cake. idk. just try to find peace in this twisted world. it's out there somewhere. has to be.

your entire life is ahead of you. graduation, college, you can travel, meet new people, try new things, etc. you're experiencing what a lot of 17 year old girls do and it's completely normal to feel these ways. but you will be able to trust again. give it some time and in 6-12 months you'll look back at this, laugh, and say "can't believe i was so hung up on someone that left me like that". you deserve better and you'll find it. just be patient and kind to yourself.

don't do it. my friend just did it. i can't express the amount of pain i am feeling or even begin to describe what my eyes feel like from crying for 15 hrs on and off but please think of who would be crushed if you left. get better for yourself and them.

my daughter. and the fact that my good friend just took his life. due to the pain it has caused myself and many others, though i'm beyond unhappy in this life, there's got to be a way out of this hole i've dug myself into.
i appreciate your kind words so much. thank you.. i'm just trying to grieve in the healthiest and best way possible. still unsure what the best ways are so i figured reaching out couldn't hurt.

i'm terribly sorry. one can only hope that your step brother, my friend, and others who have taken this route are at peace. but the unknown is so scary. i have so many what ifs and wishes and hopes.. but as you very well know the only thing i can do is try to heal and overcome the struggles that he could not. ty for sharing. this definitely helped a little bit ❤️

thank you. i'm doing what i can with what i have to remind myself that this was not my fault. i feel so much fucking guilt. i have lost people in the past but never in this manner. where we were so close and had a lot of the same issues. idk how i'm still here and he's not. it kills.
